voice.summary: Paradiso sounds like a friendly local estate agent who rings you first. It is warm, plain and prompt, with a promise to tell you early about homes close by.
dos: Name the area and the type of home
Say how soon you will be told
donts: Do not pressure with fake scarcity

taglines: Be first to know about nearby homes
Homes near you, before anyone else
Local homes, straight to your inbox
boilerplate: Paradiso notifies people about newly listed homes in their area and connects them with trusted professionals for a smooth move.

microcopy.success: You are subscribed. We will email new homes near you.
microcopy.error: That email does not look right. Check and try again.
microcopy.empty: No homes yet in your area. We will tell you when one lists.

logo.note: A home outline says where the alerts come from.
